Senses.Explanation: The whole realm was never hidden. The origin is Shishuang Qingzhu's own answer, preserved in Tianyin Yuanxiu's record: a monk asks why, a foot of space between them, he does not see the master's face — I say the whole realm was never hidden; the monk carries it to Xuefeng, who answers what place is not Shishuang; the monk reports back and Shishuang groans what death-hurry possesses that old man — and Tianyin, capping it in the hall, rules the ancients' one expedient dragged mud and water: had Qingshan been Shishuang, one staff to the head, it would never have flowed on to Xuefeng sprouting branches on branches.a monk asks why, a foot of space between them, he does not see the master's face — I say the whole realm was never hidden; the monk carries it to Xuefeng, who answers what place is not Shishuang; the monk reports back and Shishuang groans what death-hurry possesses that old man; Heyi Chaozi snatches up the staff: picked up, it fills the universe — the whole realm was never hidden — and the three-times buddhas dare not look at it straight, the successive patriarchs can only hang their mouths on the wall; when it is just so, buddha comes and gets thirty blows, demon comes and gets thirty blows, reason or none, and even that strict command is only half the提. Lianyue Daozheng, grading Yunmen's east-mountains-walking and Yuanwu's south-wind answer as awl-point clever but chisel-corner blind, answers for himself in Baoshou's seat: were someone to ask today whence the buddhas emerge — tell him only, the whole realm was never hidden. Buhui Fatong, asked at autumn's end when the ten thousand things hide away whether anything does not go with them, answers the frontier-tent of a thousand and the ten-thousand-bushel boat; pressed for the line that escapes change: the whole sky wrapped earth has no facing or back — clearly, the whole realm was never hidden. And Yulin Tongxu, when a monk answers his parents-before-birth demand by gesturing outward with the formula, turns it against him: the whole realm was never hidden — so why does it lean to that side? — and when the monk has no words: why not say, this one points east and draws west.
